Viennese Pastries

Served at: Magic Flute

Makes about 24 pastriesPrep 1 hour 30 minCook 15 min

Viennese pastries are a delightful assortment of buttery, flaky treats often enjoyed during festive occasions such as performances of Mozart's Magic Flute. These pastries reflect the rich baking traditions of Vienna and add an elegant touch to celebrations with their delicate flavors and intricate shapes.

Ingredients

  • 2 1/2 cups (320 g) all-purpose flour
  • 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar
  • 1/4 teaspoon salt
  • 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 2 large egg yolks
  • 1/4 cup (60 ml) cold milk
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1/2 cup (160 g) apricot jam
  • Powdered sugar for dusting

Method

  1. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
  2. Cut the cold butter into the flour mixture using a pastry cutter or your fingers until it resembles coarse crumbs.
  3. In a separate small bowl, whisk the egg yolks, milk, and vanilla extract together.
  4. Add the wet ingredients to the flour mixture and gently mix until a dough forms; avoid overworking.
  5. Shape the dough into a disk, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
  6. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
  7. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/8 inch (3 mm) thickness.
  8. Cut the dough into desired shapes such as crescents, stars, or circles.
  9. Place a small spoonful of apricot jam onto half of the shapes, then cover with the remaining shapes and gently press edges to seal.
  10. Arrange the pastries on the prepared baking sheets and bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
  11. Remove from oven and let cool on wire racks.
  12. Dust the cooled pastries with powdered sugar before serving.

Tips

  • For a richer flavor, brush pastries with a beaten egg before baking for a golden finish.
  • Try filling with other jams like raspberry or plum for variety.
  • Store pastries in an airtight container to keep them fresh for several days.
